items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And I was three. Oh, and Wade Whaley.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah? When you got the job, did you send for a band? It's all right. You can talk. No, you can talk. You can sit down. You can sit back.

Why I sent for a band? I sent for Louie and... Louie? Yeah. Louie went back to New Orleans at the time. Oh. And by the time my telegram got there, he had just left. For Chicago? Mm-hmm. Went with you. So who'd you get? Papa Michael. And who else? I was born in Alfred William Drum and Manuel Mineta. And I was three. Oh, and Wade Whaley. Clarence. You know. Yes, I know.

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: he played until Joe came back and I haven't seen him since.

ctx.x: And he was living in a project there in Watts. And I went there and I said, we used to go to work. He was working days, you know? And uh, his wife said, if you do work, you have to keep it quiet because you have a job in the shipyard or something. I said, what difference does that make? I said, uh, you can do ten jobs as long as you do his work on the other job, you know? Yeah. So he's got to be a henpeck, you know? Yeah. And uh, he played until Joe came back and I haven't seen him since. No.
We haven't been able to hear anything about him. Nobody knows where he is. No.
